messages:
Carmen (Design): Heads up1 On 1280px width the Vectors preview pushes Export offscreen. Attached mock. Can we make the preview collapse into a per-row chevron and surface a compact toggle in the toolbar?
Theo (Frontend): Repro. Quick wins: add 'Condensed rows' toggle (text + shortcut), collapse preview content into expandable region, and make Export a pinned primary on the right.
Rhea (Product): Also: customers hit CSV truncation on vector columns. We should recommend NDJSON for large exports and show a pre-export size estimate. Default: CSV for small exports, auto-recommend NDJSON >50MB.
Ilan (ML): Agree NDJSON + manifest.json is safest. Server can compute estimated compressed size and we can ZIP manifest + file server-side. Also cap full-vector CSV on self-serve (15k rows).
Ada (A11y): A11y notes: 1) Add aria-label and visible focus for Condensed toggle; expose keyboard shortcut (Ctrl+Shift+C) in help. 2) Export modal must be role=dialog, focus trap, aria-labelledby. 3) Relevance deltas need aria-live="polite" and text fallback like "+0.12".
Theo (Frontend): Implementation: replace textarea export with Blob streaming + anchor download, call size-estimate endpoint, and default to NDJSON when large. I'll include unit tests for long vectors and NDJSON output.
Carmen (Design): Copy: toolbar toggle label 'Condensed rows'. Export modal header 'Export dataset' and checkbox 'Include raw vectors (may be very large)'. Warning: 'This export may exceed 100MB. Consider NDJSON.' Primary CTA: 'Start export'.
Rhea (Product): Add a compressed size badge next to format selector and an opt-in 'Include manifest (recommended)'.
export-bot: Created ticket UI-5233 "Vectors preview: condensed toggle, safe export modal, NDJSON + manifest, a11y follow-ups" and linked mocks.
